records.title: OpenAI 藉助先進 AI 發現 PHP 嚴重漏洞，啓動全球協同修復機制
records.summary: OpenAI 10月21日發佈公告，公開一次由AI牽頭、多國機構與企業協同完成的PHP漏洞修復全過程。行動依託其“Patch the Planet”計劃，聯合軟件維護者、安全研究人員、雲服務商及政府網絡安全機構，目標是在攻擊者利用前處置兩項嚴重PHP漏洞，降低全球互聯網風險，凸顯AI驅動、跨組織協作的安全響應新模式。

records.title: PHP 爆出"PHP2Shell"高危漏洞：影響約七成網站，OpenAI 牽頭全球協防
records.summary: OpenAI 21日稱，借“修補地球”計劃協助發現PHP兩項嚴重漏洞，並聯合維護方、安全公司、雲商及多國網安機構，公開前協調修復約兩個月。漏洞統稱“PHP2Shell”，編號CVE-2026-109618、109619，CVSS v4.0均達9.2。Calif用GPT-5.6 Sol發現一關鍵缺陷，谷歌Wiz獨立上報，PHP官方維護者主導修復。

records.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
records.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too. The article OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites appeared first on The Decoder .

records.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
records.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .

records.title: Anthropic甩出Claude Haiku 5.5：小模型成本砍掉75%，推理強度也能自己調了
records.summary: Anthropic於10月8日發佈Claude Haiku5.5，定位爲迄今最快、能力最強的小型模型，面向高頻、成本敏感任務，如摘要、分類、數據庫查詢、客服應答、瀏覽器自動化和大型AI智能體子任務。官方稱其平均運行成本較上一代大幅降低，意在用輕量高效覆蓋高性價比場景。

records.title: Anthropic 重磅發佈 Claude Haiku 5.5！價格暴降 90% 但面臨隱性成本
records.summary: Anthropic推出Claude 5.5系列輕量模型Claude Haiku 5.5。10萬Token內常規請求，輸入和輸出每百萬Token分別降至0.10和0.50美元，較前代賬面價降90%。該模型響應最快，主打高併發、低延遲、高性價比，適合實時客服、摘要提取、數據分類等高頻任務，並首次加入自適應思考等功能。

records.title: OpenAI給GPT-6.1 Sol擴容記憶：默認上下文頂到 50 萬，長文本不再單獨計費
records.summary: 10月12日，OpenAI的Tibo宣佈，Codex和Work環境中GPT-6.1Sol默認上下文窗口從27.2萬token提升至50萬token，擴容約80%。他表示後續還會繼續擡高上限，但此次調整已能顯著降低“上下文壓縮”觸發頻率。該機制指模型容量不足時，被迫歸納並丟棄前文內容，曾困擾重度代碼用戶。

records.title: OpenAI 給 GPT-6.1 Sol 擴容：默認上下文 272k 飆到 500k，長文本還免費
records.summary: OpenAI工程師Tibo宣佈，Codex與Work環境中GPT-6.1 Sol默認上下文從272k tokens提升至500k，增幅約80%。單次對話可處理篇幅近乎翻倍，更易應對整座代碼庫、長篇報告及跨多輪複雜任務，減少自動壓縮、中途截斷或強制摘要，例如在數百頁合同中持續追蹤信息。

records.title: OpenAI adds GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast at six times standard API prices

records.title: OpenAI重磅發佈GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast版，速度最高提升 8 倍

records.title: ​OpenAI 升級 ChatGPT 擴展：多標籤頁聯動與網頁智能代辦全面上線
records.summary: OpenAI升級ChatGPT瀏覽器擴展。用戶在對話中提及Chrome，即可讓AI讀取多個已打開標籤頁作爲上下文，實現跨頁面內容比對、資料智能整理及瀏覽器端任務協助。官方稱，新版還能彙總不同供應商產品價格與功能、協助整理表格等，提升信息處理效率。

records.title: ChatGPT 瀏覽器擴展大升級：能讀你開着的標籤頁，還替你填表發信
records.summary: OpenAI近日升級ChatGPT瀏覽器擴展。新版允許用戶在對話中直接“點名”Chrome，讓助手讀取已打開網頁標籤作爲上下文，進而比較頁面、歸整資料或接手瀏覽器操作。官方場景包括彙總供應商價格與功能、整理表格、預填表單，以及依據網頁信息起草郵件。側邊欄也更好用，瀏覽網頁時可隨時呼出ChatGPT。

records.title: OpenAI發佈ChatGPT擴展程序重大升級，支持跨標籤頁上下文讀取與自動化操作
records.summary: OpenAI宣佈Chrome擴展重大升級，面向所有套餐用戶開放，正式將計算機使用能力引入主流瀏覽器。此次更新深度整合瀏覽器上下文與操作權限，使AI從單純信息檢索跨越到主動任務執行。擴展在Chat和Work兩種模式下提供差異化能力，其中Chat模式可跨多個已打開的Chrome標籤頁自動讀取並匯聚上下文信息，強化自動化操作與任務執行。

records.title: OpenAI 升級 ChatGPT 瀏覽器擴展，支持跨標籤頁讀取與自動化操作
records.summary: OpenAI對Chrome版ChatGPT擴展進行重大升級，將“計算機使用”能力引入瀏覽器，並向所有套餐用戶開放，不再限於高端訂閱。升級後插件分成兩副面孔，各管一攤：Chat模式像安靜的觀察者，能跨多個已打開的Chrome標籤頁。這意味着原本只會聊天、搜資料的側邊欄，開始具備實際操作能力，向更主動的瀏覽器助手進化。

records.title: ‘This Is Not a Drill’: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Are Setting the Internet on Fire
records.summary: The PHP Foundation has revealed two serious vulnerabilities that could impact millions of websites. Security experts warn that failure to quickly patch the flaws could have dire consequences.

records.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
records.summary: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security If you're running anything on PHP it's vital you upgrade - today's updates (across the entire PHP 8.x line) address two remote code execution holes, and there have been exploits circulating since last night, thanks to a leak in the coordinated disclosure process. This post from the PHP Foundation explain what went so wrong: On Tuesday, October 20th, at around 15:00 UTC, the two CVE IDs began circulating on online forums and social media. They came with a wrong release time and a wrong CVSS score of 10.0 (the actual score is 9.2). No technical details leaked. In response, the PHP project brought its pre-announcement forward and published it at 19:30 UTC . It also moved the release from October 22nd, 14:00 UTC, to October 21st, 14:00 UTC [...] As a result of the leak and pre-announcement around 20:00 UTC, Calif, one of the security firms that had reported the issues mistakenly published a video. It showed their proof of concept working against a number of targets and revealed a few additional, though limited, details about the vulnerabilities. Copies of the deleted video started circulating on social media soon after. The video contributed to accelerated development of various PoCs (exploitation proof of concepts), which then increased circulation on October 21st. This article from the team that discovered the original vulnerability includes a more detailed timeline of the original intended responsible disclosure: August 19, 2026: Wiz Research discovers the first PHP vulnerability using Wiz Atlas, Gemini 4
